why_relevant: SI-origin fintech vendor for central and commercial banks (e-banking, payments, digital signing) across EMEA; hiring and leadership posts indicate market expansion and product bets.
Ljubljana search firm explicitly consulting in banking and finance; its published mandates, blog and salary/HR commentary reveal which bank roles are being filled before appointments become public.
Network parent page confirming Competo as the SI member; useful for cross-border mandate signals and for snowballing to other Adria offices covering SI banking clients.

source_name: Amrop Adria (Ljubljana) - executive search & board advisory
why_relevant: One of the oldest SI executive search firms (est. 1998, Ljubljana), doing board consulting and leadership assessment; publishes insights and occasionally placement/board-appointment commentary relevant to bank supervisory boards.

source_name: TRESCON Slovenia (CFR Global Executive Search) - executive search and selection
why_relevant: SI member of CFR Global since 2005; mandate announcements and published vacancies for management roles are an early proxy for organisational change at client banks.
Global search firm with a Ljubljana office; Boyden publishes placement announcements and 'leadership insights' that name appointed executives, a classic recruiter-benefits-from-publicity channel.
CEE search firm naming Financial Services as a Ljubljana specialism; its news section routinely publishes named placement announcements - directly usable leadership-move intelligence.

source_name: Stanton Chase Belgrade (Adria desk covering Slovenia)
why_relevant: Serves SI from Belgrade with a dedicated financial services practice; regional mandates and thought-leadership on banking leadership hiring cover Slovenia.

source_name: Kadring d.o.o. - Slovenian HR / search agency
why_relevant: Established SI recruitment agency (Ljubljana/Novo mesto) named in the cell brief; publishes vacancy ads that often anonymise but describe the client sector, useful for detecting bank/fintech hiring.

source_name: Optius.com - NLB d.d. employer profile page
why_relevant: Employer-scoped vacancy view for the largest SI bank; volume and role mix over time is a clean proxy for reorganisation and digital/payments investment.

source_name: Glassdoor - NLB Group employer profile and reviews
why_relevant: Employee-review data (ratings, culture, career-opportunity scores, salary bands) is the main talent-intelligence read on internal morale and restructuring pressure at the largest SI bank.

source_name: CEE Chamber - Top recruitment agencies in Ljubljana (directory article)
why_relevant: Pointer article enumerating SI recruitment/search agencies with sector specialisms - the cheapest way to expand the actor map beyond the four firms named in the brief.
Slovenian-language pointer listing local HR agencies and their terminology - a glossary and actor-map source in the local language rather than an English directory.

why_relevant: Slovenian media periodically publishes consolidated 'new names at the helm' pieces naming bank management board changes (e.g. Nova KBM board change) - cheap corroboration for LinkedIn-sourced moves.
The job portal's own LinkedIn feed republishes featured vacancies and labour-market commentary, giving a low-friction English/Slovenian mixed stream that surfaces employer campaigns.

National daily of record; its Gospodarstvo and Kariera subsections carry bank appointment stories (e.g. SID banka board president appointment, NLB board changes, UniCredit Banka Slovenija leadership completion). Kariera is effectively an appointments/personnel column.
Delo's dedicated capital-markets/business brand with a 'Finance' vertical; runs analytical pieces on bank governance, restructuring and management-board strategy that contextualise personnel moves.

Fully open access — best free structured feed for this cell.

Major Ljubljana daily with an economy/business section covering corporate governance and appointments; adds a second independent editorial read on contested bank/state-holding personnel decisions.
